news.description: SK hynix commences ADR trading with an 'Opening Bell' ceremony attended by SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won and key executive leadershipCompany aims to expand investor base and solidify leadership as a 'Core AI Partner' in the memory marketCEO Kwak Noh-Jung 'I'd like to thank investors and customers and pledge to unlock memory's potential and empower employees to achieve more'SEOUL, South Korea, July 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SK hynix Inc. They also allow U.S. investors to invest in foreign companies through the U.S. market without opening overseas brokerage accounts or dealing with foreign currency transactions.
